name: Warp Deformer Alt Symmetry Host Validation Probe
description: Task-local reconnaissance probe for Warp deformer control points on an exact Cubism host: reads every Warp grid, proves the SDK grid write/hook/native-Undo round-trip, and (opt-in) records what a real Alt-drag in the modeling viewport does to the grid.

permissions.reason: Reads every Warp deformer grid and the active model identity to record the probe baseline.
Performs one bounded Warp grid replacement on the task-scoped fixture copy to prove the read/write/hook/native-Undo path the feature depends on.
Receives the on/after Warp-grid hook callbacks that the Alt-symmetry feature must observe; without it the runtime registers no Deformer observer and the hook family cannot be verified.

Receives the before Warp-grid hook so the probe can verify the rewrite-capable interception point the Alt-symmetry feature would return a mirrored grid from. The probe never rewrites the grid; it returns the value it was given.
